caseNameFull: John H. Hall, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Oregon.
attorneys: Mr. John H. Hall for the plaintiff in error., The Attorney General for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Dismissed, on motion of Mr. Solicitor General Bullitt for the defendant in error, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the District of Oregon.
